Definition: to sprout (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to sprout, spring up, grow up; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to sprout, spring up; 1a1a) of plants; 1a1b) of hair; 1a1c) of speech (fig.); 1b) (Piel) to grow abundantly or thickly; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to grow; 1c2) to cause to sprout
